plan.from: The domain's role with respect to this data object. master: authoritative owner of some slice in a holistic deployment. embedded_master: point-solution local master — owns its own copy when deployed standalone; demoted to consumer at runtime when a canonical master is also deployed in the same environment. contributor: writes some fields without being authoritative. consumer: reads only. derived: produces computed projections only. Combined with the necessity column, embedded_master+required rows count toward the Signal 1 multi-master integration-burden score; embedded_master+optional rows do not.

Combined with the necessity column, embedded_master+required rows count toward the Signal 1 multi-master integration-burden score; embedded_master+optional rows do not.
